name: Abingdon Spares
old_description: in 1968 in Needham, MA. Jerry was a sports car enthusiast, who also founded and directed The Westminster MG Car Museum in Westminster, VT.
about:
Abingdon Spares was founded in 1968 in Needham, Massachusetts, by Jerry Goguen, a sports-car enthusiast who also established the Westminster MG Car Museum in Vermont. The business began as a specialist supplier for MG T-series (TC, TD, TF) models.

The company stocks new-old-stock (NOS) and reproduction components for MG T-series and MGB vehicles, including engine internals, carburetion, fuel systems, braking, electrical, cooling, and body trim. Operating from a facility in Gorham, Maine, it maintains a comprehensive inventory of parts such as SU carburetor kits, wiring harnesses, brake components, and wood or sheet-metal body pieces. The catalog spans thousands of part numbers across mechanical, electrical, and cosmetic categories.

Abingdon Spares serves classic-car restorers, MG club members, and vintage-racing participants worldwide. Customers range from individual owners rebuilding a single TC to shops preparing MGBs for competition. The company also supplies technical resources—installation guides, identification charts, and a monthly “MG of the Month” feature—to support the enthusiast community.

The firm emphasizes depth of inventory and model-specific expertise, positioning itself as a single-source specialist for T-series and MGB parts. Its history of continuous operation under successive owners reflects a commitment to preserving the MG marque’s parts supply.

name: Abundant Energy of Arkansas
old_description: Solar panels produce renewable clean energy while securing low utility rates. Our panels exceed industry standards for durability and lifespan.
about:
Abundant Energy of Arkansas operates from Booneville, Arkansas, serving homeowners across Western Arkansas and Eastern Oklahoma. The company has been in business for over nine years as of 2025, though a specific founding year is not publicly disclosed. Ownership structure and founder names have not been shared publicly.

The firm specializes in solar photovoltaic installation, offering grid-tied and off-grid systems, as well as wind energy solutions. It is the only factory-authorized dealer for LG ESS battery storage systems in Western Arkansas. Services include custom system design, permitting, installation by licensed electricians, and post-installation inspection by utility engineers. The company also provides maintenance and repair for existing arrays, including those installed by competitors, and sells complete solar kits for do-it-yourself homeowners. Staff experience totals more than 30 years combined.

Primary customers are residential property owners seeking to reduce utility costs or achieve energy independence in remote locations where grid extension is impractical. The company also serves DIY enthusiasts who prefer to self-install using supplied kits. Its service territory spans Western Arkansas and Eastern Oklahoma.

Abundant Energy emphasizes customer education about solar operation, competitive pricing, and reliable repair service for storm damage or system failure. Its stated differentiators include exclusive LG ESS authorization in the region, a willingness to service competitor-installed systems, and a focus on off-grid solutions that eliminate the need for net-metering agreements.

name: Accessibility Medical Equipment
old_description: Rhythm Healthcare P2 Portable Oxygen Concentrator (Rx Required)
about:
Accessibility Medical Equipment operates as a non-profit in Kansas City, Missouri The organization is sustained by community donations of medical equipment and a grant from the Missouri Assistive Technology Advisory Council, which funds its equipment recycling and reuse program.

The organization collects donated durable medical equipment, then inspects, refurbishes, cleans, and sanitizes each item using a process that exceeds CDC and CMS standards, including laboratory-grade disinfectant and a 360-degree Fahrenheit commercial steam system. It sells both refurbished and new medical equipment—mobility aids, bathroom safety products, hospital beds, lifts, respiratory devices, and daily living supplies—and also provides repair services and equipment rentals.

Its customers include seniors, individuals with disabilities, people with temporary medical needs, and the organizations that serve them. The company accepts Medicare, Kansas Medicaid, and Missouri Medicaid, and imposes no purchase qualifications.

Accessibility Medical Equipment was founded on the principle that cost should not block access to medical equipment needed for recovery, independence, or quality of life, especially when gently used equipment is available in the community.

The company supplies a wide range of FDA-certified products, from disposable single-use items to hospital beds. It does not manufacture these goods; instead, it acts as a distributor and supply-chain partner, managing inventory and logistics to meet the needs of healthcare facilities.

Acro serves hospitals, clinics, and other healthcare providers, focusing on the medical and healthcare industries. name: Action Auto Parts
old_description: Providing you, our customer, with excellent service for over 40 years!
about:
Action Auto Parts operates as an authorized warehouse distributor of automotive parts and supplies from two locations in Providence, Rhode Island. The company has served the region for over 40 years, building a reputation as a top distributor of auto parts in the state. Ownership details and founder names are not publicly disclosed.

The business stocks parts for both foreign and domestic vehicles and runs a dedicated battery division, State Battery Warehouse, which supplies everything from key-fob and AA batteries to new and used automotive batteries and electric forklift batteries. A staff of over 100 includes ASE-certified parts specialists with an average tenure exceeding ten years. Operations are supported by an electronic cataloging and inventory management system, and delivery drivers are GPS-tracked to enable same-day service across the Providence area.

Customers range from independent repair shops and fleet operators to walk-in retail buyers. The company emphasizes accurate parts identification and warrants that its product warranties meet or exceed the original manufacturers' guidelines.

Action Auto Parts was founded on a commitment to customer service, aiming to provide the right part at the right price with rapid fulfillment. Its differentiators include same-day delivery, a deep bench of certified counter personnel, and a technology-driven inventory system that tracks purchases and returns in detail.
